ModMetaData.name: DMSSR 孤立子活性衰减 / Soliton Charge Decay
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
让 Synthriada 的五种孤立子光束武器系统在停火后按原生 coldTime 线性衰减，并显示剩余活性；重型集束器和执迷之眼保留 6 秒冷却，聚焦器 2 秒，手枪和散布器 1 秒。恢复开火时继承尚未消散的活性。安全模式的过热停火、强制冷却及反馈伤害规则保持原样。
Enables the native coldTime-based linear activity decay for all five Synthriada particle-beam weapon systems and displays their remaining activity while idle. Firing resumes with the remaining charge. Preserves safety-mode forced cooling and overheat feedback rules.
